author: The Q
description:
You upgraded your iPhone. But what about the thing that charges it?
Meet the Anker Nano Smart Display Charger - a tiny charger with up to 55W of power, smart iPhone recognition, real-time charging information, and features designed to help protect your battery.
From intelligent charging with Apple’s AVS protocol to Care Mode for overnight charging, this compact charger does much more than you might expect.
